prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright snowfield with bare trees under a pale sky, a wooden fence of normal height and a cabin with a standard-size door in the distance, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult American woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, a lead round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a lead barrel-shaped weight, a silver hammer head, a bronze ship's anchor, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold round bell, a gold miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long square nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries overlapping mother-of-pearl nacre tiles set edge to edge over her skin, each tile with a fine edge and a soft milky lustre that shifts through rainbow colours across every curve, BLAZING black Tahitian-pearl nacre with green and violet lustre, VIVID soft peacock-green and violet sheen sliding across each tile. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Uzbek man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a playful half-grin, sleek silver-grey hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a gold cube-shaped block, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop with a heavy rough tin a round bell hanging at its end, and a single mixed-metal anklet. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large giant of a man, far beyond any real person, big-bellied with great size throughout. Broad powerful shoulders, a wide heavy chest, a large round soft belly hanging over a thick waist, thick strong arms, and wide heavy thighs beneath. Every curve is large, solid and continuous, with a warm, imposing bearing. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries solid thick stained glass fused to his form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands on his hips, elbows out.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme gold platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
